headline: Absa Group Opens Dubai Office to Connect Gulf Capital with African Markets
summary: Absa Group has opened a new office in Dubai to strengthen trade and investment flows between Middle Eastern markets and Africa.
why: Cross-border expansion by major regional lenders facilitates capital flows and trade financing between emerging African economies and international financial hubs like the Middle East.

impacts.name: Absa Group
impacts.why: Absa Group is expanding its geographic footprint by opening a new office.
